task_description: Insert the peg vertically into the target hole.

observations.name: hole_axis
observations.description: Hole insertion axis in world coordinates.

observations.name: goal_quat
observations.description: Peg orientation required by the hole.

observations.name: grasped
observations.description: Whether the robot currently has a native two-finger grasp on the peg.

stages.description: Approach the peg, descend to a valid grasp pose, and close the gripper.
stages.rationale: The grasp predicate gives an independent physical endpoint; the TCP-to-peg distance remains useful for multi-segment matching despite descent and gripper-settling reversals.

stages.description: Lift and transport the grasped peg, then align its body and tip with the vertical hole axis.
stages.metric: lateral_distance(peg_head_pos, hole_pos, hole_axis) + lateral_distance(peg_pos, goal_pos, hole_axis) + 0.05 * orientation_error(peg_quat, goal_quat)
stages.end_condition: boolean_state(grasped) >= 1.0 and lateral_distance(peg_head_pos, hole_pos, hole_axis) < 0.02 and lateral_distance(peg_pos, goal_pos, hole_axis) < 0.02 and orientation_error(peg_quat, goal_quat) < 0.25 and distance(peg_pos, goal_pos) < 0.22
stages.rationale: Lift, transfer, and lateral correction form one physical alignment operation with a naturally multi-modal trajectory; lateral and angular errors identify readiness without requiring insertion-depth progress.

stages.description: Advance the aligned peg along the hole axis until the environment reports insertion.
stages.rationale: Tip displacement plus orientation error supports reference matching through contact corrections, while the native insertion predicate supplies the physical endpoint.
